shell.about: Metres, except the margin in hexes. A timber-framed or rubble outer wall of a house, inn or hall; the street door in the middle of the front wall, never more than half the wall; ground kept around the footprint inside the frame; floors open at tabletop squares.

levels.about: What a creator calls each level; deeper cellars and higher floors are numbered.

connections.about: Kinds that carry people between levels or maps. On another map a connection reaches a cave (its passages, chambers, mouths and walls) or a building's doors, stairs and trapdoors; on its own map, a stair, ladder, trapdoor or shaft on another level (its landing).
